newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada C$2.7 bln bond due 2002 yields 5.701 pct.
newsitem.headline: Canada C$2.7 bln bond due 2002 yields 5.701 pct.

text.p: The Government of Canada said its C$2.7 billion auction of 5.5 percent bonds due September 1, 2002 produced the following results:
The bonds will be dated and delivered on March 3. Bids from primary dealers totalled C$5,919.4 million, including C$61.9 million non-competitive tenders at the average yield.
Proceeds will used to redeem C$3.4 billion of bonds maturing March 1.
The Bank of Canada had said earlier it would acquire at least C$405 million of the new bonds and that it held C$101 million of the maturing bonds.
The total amount of the issue outstanding is now C$2.7 billion. ((Reuters Toronto Bureau (416) 941-8100))
